title: Handoff Sprint Playbook and Livestream Notes
content:
Purpose:
- Run a focused handoff sprint to finalize Q4 -> Q1 OKRs, rehearse the company all-hands livestream, and produce the executive update for board/staff. This is intentionally short + tactical: align leadership decisions, validate comms, and leave with a publishable OKR slate and slide deck.

Scope and constraints:
- Scope: company-wide OKRs, top-level product metrics, cost/latency guardrails, and all-hands messaging. Not in scope: deep product feature specs or individual team sprint plans (these stay in team folders).
- Constraints: limited runway for engineering capacity changes before the end-of-quarter freeze; Dedicated contract renewals may restrict infrastructure changes.

High-level sprint timeline (week-of):
- Day -2 (Prep): finalize pre-read, collect dashboard screenshots, confirm speakers.
- Day 0 (Leadership sync): 90m decision session, surface unresolved KRs, lock owners.
- Day 1 (Rehearsal): full slide run-through with tech check; identify backup narratives.
- Day 2 (All-hands livestream): 75min event (slides + 20min moderated Q&A).
- Day 3 (Breakouts): team-level OKR alignment sessions and intake for rollouts.
- Day 4 (Publish): produce final OKR doc, publish Confluence page, update roadmap board.

All-hands livestream: run of show (75 minutes)
- 0:00–0:05 Intro and framing (Host: Avery)
- 0:05–0:15 Executive recap: wins since last quarter (CEO)
- 0:15–0:30 Product state and metrics (Head of Product + Lead Eng)
- 0:30–0:40 Customer story / case study (Customer Success)
- 0:40–0:55 OKR proposals: objectives + 2–3 KRs each (Exec list)
- 0:55–1:05 Rollout & reliability commitments (SRE/Infra)
- 1:05–1:20 Live Q&A (moderated)

Roles and responsibilities during event
- Host / MC: Avery Brooks (script + pacing).
- Producer / Stream ops: Marcus Kim (stream keys, recording, fallback).
- Q&A moderator: Lena Ortiz (triages Slack/Slido, routes questions).
- Slide shepherd: Priya Desai (ensures slides are final and on-brand).
- Exec decision authority: CEO + COO (final tiebreakers).

Live stream safety net (must have):
- Primary and secondary streaming keys configured (Marcus).
- Pre-recorded segment of the product demo (2min) uploaded and tested.
- Local recording initiated 10m prior; cloud recording enabled.
- Alternate meeting room reserved for audio-only fallback.

Slide deck outline (recommended slide counts)
1) Cover + agenda (1)
2) Executive topline (3): revenue signal, usage trends, major wins
3) Health metrics (5): p50/p95 latency, cost per token, error rate, capacity utilization
4) Customer highlight (2)
5) OKR proposals (6–8): each objective with 2–4 KRs, owners, and thresholds
6) Reliability & capacity commitments (2)
7) Rollout plan & dependencies (2)
8) Ask / what we need from teams (1)
9) Q&A / next steps (1)

OKR draft (top-level summary — for exec decision session)
- Objective A: Make inference predictable and cost-efficient
  - KR A1: Reduce p95 online generation latency from 310ms to <=260ms across hosted API (owner: Marcus Kim)
  - KR A2: Improve cache hit ratio from 8% to 20% on steady-state traffic (owner: Eng Optimize, Priya Desai)
  - KR A3: Lower median cost-per-token on typical 2k-seq workloads by 12% via batching & quantization recommendations (owner: Research/Optimize)

- Objective B: Expand enterprise adoption with Dedicated & Private offerings
  - KR B1: Close 3 new Dedicated contracts with >$50k ARR each (owner: Sales Enterprise)
  - KR B2: Ship private-deployments quicker: reduce onboarding time from avg 28d to 18d (owner: Solutions Eng, Tomás Navarro)

- Objective C: Developer experience & observability improvements
  - KR C1: Publish 8 new SDK feature parity items and two major tutorials (owner: DevX)
  - KR C2: Reduce mean time to identify perf regressions from 4h to 90m with alerts + runbooks (owner: Observability)

Decision criteria for finalizing OKRs
- Executive agreement threshold: 70% of exec team must sign off; unresolved items are escalated to CEO within 48h.
- Metric feasibility: KRs tied to observable dashboards and owners must have a measurement plan.
- Resource redlines: any KR that requires >3 FTE sustained work must include a staffing plan or be explicitly deferred.

Risk scenarios and mitigations (top ones)
- Capacity crunch during rollout: pre-allocate burst capacity for Dedicated trials; enable automatic fallback routing to compatible model variants. (Owner: Infra)
- Live demo failure: switch to pre-recorded demo; skip to Q&A and debrief immediately. (Owner: Marcus)
- OKR disagreement across leadership: hold 2-hour exec alignment with prepared tradeoff analysis; if unresolved, defer to CEO.

Communications plan (timeline)
- T-72h: Send pre-read (one-pager + dashboards) to all staff; link to rehearsal notes.
- T-24h: Reminder with highlights and host instructions.
- T-1h: Go/no-go technical check (streaming keys, recording).
- Post-event (within 24h): Publish recording, Q&A digest, and final OKR doc to Confluence; individual teams get a follow-up note with action items.

Rehearsal checklist (technical + narrative)
- Tech check (T-2h): verify camera, mic, stream keys, captions.
- Slide flow run (T-4h): full timed run with at least one exec. 90% of slides must be final.
- Q&A dry run (T-6h): prepare 10 seeded Qs and model answers; confirm who answers which category.

Q&A prep (seeded questions and answers)
- Q: How will we maintain latency SLOs as we scale customers?
  A: Short answer + reference to planned batching and routing policies and capacity reservations. (Answer owner: Marcus)
- Q: Will pricing change with the new cost optimizations?
  A: No immediate public price change; cost savings are being reinvested into SRE and discounts for committed capacity. (Answer owner: Finance/COO)

Action tracker template (to be created as Sheet)
- Action text | Owner | Due date | Priority | Status (open/in-progress/done)
- Example: "Confirm Dedicated burst capacity for Q1 trials" | Tomás Navarro | 2024-11-01 | High | open

Open questions and blockers
- Legal: any new contract language required for Dedicated customers expected in Q1? (Owner: Legal — Emily Shaw)
- Data residency: final list of regions for Private in APAC needed for sales motions. (Owner: Solutions Eng)
- Dashboard coverage: do current telemetry dashboards support the proposed KR measurements? (Owner: Observability — Priya)

Appendix / links (for sprint pack)
- Prior exec update: https://confluence.redwood.company/display/RE/exec-update-2024-07
- Telemetry dashboards: https://dashboards.redwood.company/d/QoL/inference-health
- Slides repo (work in progress): https://github.com/redwood-inference/allhands-slides/pull/12

Notes to self / rough checklist (stream-of-consciousness items for sprint)
- Confirm CEO availability for Day 2 window (Avery)
- Push final deck to branch: allhands/2024-q1-handoff (Priya)
- Reserve smaller breakout rooms and assign facilitators (Lena)
- Prepare two short contingency scripts: (1) capacity alert mid-event, (2) executive late-arrival

Status: this doc is a working draft. After leadership sync (Day 0) we will produce a locked "final OKR + deck" artifact and move to in_review -> final.
